summary: Iteration 2 focused on responsiveness, design polish (no green), 4-item primary nav + More dropdown, EN/HI toggle, mobile menu, and the new admin Translations (EN/HI) module. Backend: 45/45 pytest passing (10 new tests added for design/i18n/translations CRUD). Frontend: verified 5 viewports (1440/1200/1024/768/390) with 0px horizontal overflow, exactly 4 primary nav items + More dropdown showing 6 sub-links with icon prefixes, EN↔HI toggle switches nav labels (होम/हमारे बारे में/सेवाएं/डॉक्टर्स/और), mobile menu shows all 10 links + Call + Book CTAs, no green text/font/border colors anywhere on page (0 matching elements found via computed style scan).

issues: data-testid naming differs slightly from spec: header uses 'header-call-btn' and 'header-book-btn' (with -btn suffix) instead of exactly 'header-call'/'header-book'. Buttons exist visually as circular icon-only elements (confirmed via screenshot). Similarly the SVG logo mark exists (visually confirmed) but the wrapper does not carry data-testid='brand-mark' — the parent 'admin-login-link' testid is used for the anchor. These are naming-convention mismatches, not visual/functional bugs.

action_items: OPTIONAL (naming polish only): Add explicit data-testid='header-call', 'header-book', and 'brand-mark' attributes if the spec's exact testid names matter to downstream automation. Current 'header-call-btn'/'header-book-btn' work functionally.
critical_code_review_comments: Responsiveness is solid: 0px horizontal overflow at 1440/1200/1024/768/390. Header does not wrap or cramp at any breakpoint.
Design palette compliance verified: no green anywhere in text/font/border. Only WhatsApp floating button uses green (background only), which is allowed.

Desktop menu correctly collapsed to 4 primary items (Home/About/Services/Doctors) + More dropdown with 6 grouped links (Gallery, Events, Offers, Testimonials, Blog, Contact) each with icon prefix — exactly matches user requirement.
Mobile hamburger menu (data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle') opens full drawer with all 10 nav links + Call/Book CTAs. Works cleanly at 390px width.
Fraunces + Manrope fonts loaded (verified in layout.blade.php and site.css computed styles).
Text-based logo fallback (brand-fallback) has been REMOVED as required; a clean SVG mark renders in its place at both header and footer.

Language toggle: /lang/hi session route switches all ui() strings to Hindi; verified nav labels change to होम/हमारे बारे में/सेवाएं/डॉक्टर्स/और/गैलरी/कार्यक्रम/ऑफर्स/रोगी अनुभव/ब्लॉग/संपर्क. Persists across pages via session.

Admin Translations (EN/HI) module fully functional: sidebar link present, index page loads with search input + seed defaults + add buttons (all with correct data-testids), seed-defaults inserts 36 default rows, create/edit/delete flow verified end-to-end.
Contact form still persists enquiries; admin dashboard + enquiries listing render correctly.
Full admin CRUD retest for Doctors passes (create → visible on public /doctors → edit → delete).
